query: How do I make scrambled eggs?

goal.title: Cook and plate scrambled eggs
goal.description: Crack and beat two eggs, heat an oiled frying pan, pour in the eggs and let them set briefly, then scrape and fold them into curds. Transfer the eggs to a plate and grind pepper and salt over them.
goal.final_state: A plate of scrambled eggs sits on the counter after pepper and salt grinding, with both grinders returned to their rack.

procedure.description: Approach the stove, open upper cupboard doors, take a pale blue mixing bowl from a stack and carry it to the counter beside the egg carton.
Open the cutlery drawer, retrieve a fork, push the drawer shut and put the fork beside the bowl. Open the egg carton, tear a paper towel from its roll and lay it on the counter, then pick up an egg.

Tap and pull open the first egg over the bowl, drain it and put its shell on the towel. Take a second egg from the carton, crack and open it above the bowl, drain its contents and add its shell to the towel.
Hold the bowl in the left hand and beat the two eggs rapidly with the fork until the yolks and whites become a more uniform yellow liquid. Rest the fork in the bowl and put it down.

Open the lower pan storage drawer, retrieve a frying pan and place it on the front right burner. Open the upper cupboard, take an olive oil bottle, close the cupboard and set the bottle on the counter. Turn the stove control several times until blue flame is visible beneath the pan.

Unscrew the green cap, pour a small stream of olive oil into the pan, recap the bottle and set it down. Lift and repeatedly tilt the pan over the flame so the oil moves across the base, then rest the pan on the grate.

Open the utensil drawer, retrieve a black spatula and place it beside the stove. Open the plate cupboard, take a dark green plate and set it on the adjacent counter. Return to the bowl and stir the eggs again with the fork.

Set the bowl down, lift and tilt the pan again to move the oil around its base, then rest it. Pick up the egg bowl with the fork inside, carry it above the pan and tip it so the beaten eggs flow into the hot oil. Hold the inverted bowl briefly as the final drips fall.

Put the empty bowl down and watch the eggs cook without stirring. The outer portions become paler and firmer. Briefly touch the pan handle, then retrieve the spatula and begin probing the edge of the set egg.

Hold the pan handle and push the spatula across its base, scraping the set layer inward and folding it over the remaining liquid. Repeat from different sides, dividing and turning the eggs into soft irregular curds. Near 245–246s reach to turn the burner control, then regrasp the pan.

Lift the pan from the stove and carry it over the green plate. Repeatedly scoop eggs with the spatula and scrape smaller remaining pieces down the tilted pan onto the plate. Return the pan to the stove with the spatula resting inside, retrieve the fork and reposition the plate.

Lift the pepper grinder, remove its cap and twist it over the plated eggs. After the fine track ends at 285s, continue grinding until about 286.3s, recap and return the grinder by about 290s. Retrieve the pink salt grinder, remove its cap, grind over the eggs at about 293.1–296.2s, recap and return it to the rack by about 300.2s, then withdraw the hands.
